links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated autism responses versus recommended paediatric 6th-8th grade level
links.effect: Readability levels consistently exceeded recommended guidelines for paediatric health materials (6th-8th grade reading level) across platforms.
links.quote: Several tools produced generally accurate explanations of ASD; however, readability levels consistently exceeded recommended guidelines for paediatric health materials (i.e., the 6th-8th grade reading level).

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility (readability) of AI-generated autism information
links.effect: Readability consistently exceeded recommended 6th-8th grade level for paediatric health materials.
links.quote: Several tools produced generally accurate explanations of ASD; however, readability levels consistently exceeded recommended guidelines for paediatric health materials (i.e., the 6th-8th grade reading level).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation benchmarking the accuracy, readability, language framing, actionability, and references of health information generated by six commercial LLMs in response to autism-related questions.
